categories.main_business_segments: Kingdee International operates primarily in enterprise management cloud SaaS solutions, including cloud services and ERP business. Its cloud services segment includes products like Kingdee Cloud Cosmic (AI platform), Constellation (large enterprise SaaS), Galaxy (mid-sized enterprise SaaS), and Stellar (small and micro enterprise SaaS). The ERP business and other related services form a smaller portion of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary AI technologies, notably the Kingdee Cloud Cosmic AI platform and AI Agents, to integrate AI with ERP systems. It emphasizes no-code/low-code development platforms for enterprise AI agents and focuses on scenario-driven AI applications. The production involves cloud-based SaaS delivery models with continuous R&D investment in AI, finance, HR, and tax digital capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kingdee serves a broad range of enterprises including large state-owned enterprises, Fortune 500 companies, mid-sized growing enterprises, and small and micro businesses. Key customers include industry leaders such as Hisense Group, CNPC, AirChina, SHEIN, and Tsingtao Beer. The company also serves governments and organizations globally, with over 7.4 million customers worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with significant operations across mainland China. It has expanded its global footprint with operational hubs in Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Middle East, supporting Chinese enterprises' international expansion and localized services.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kingdee operates primarily as a software and cloud service provider in the midstream of the enterprise software supply chain, delivering SaaS solutions and digital transformation services directly to enterprises and organizations. It also engages in software development, implementation, and consulting services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Kingdee’s strategic focus is on accelerating AI integration with ERP (AI First), deepening subscription-based cloud service models (Subscription First), and expanding global presence (Globalization). R&D priorities include enhancing the Kingdee Cloud Cosmic AI platform, developing AI applications for finance, HR, supply chain, and manufacturing, and fostering ecosystem partnerships with leading AI and technology firms.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue mainly through cloud subscription services (approximately 81.6% of total revenue), including SaaS subscriptions and related services. Additional revenue comes from ERP software sales, implementation, consulting, maintenance, and upgrade services. It also earns rental income from investment properties and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kingdee is a market leader in China’s enterprise application software sector, holding #1 positions in SaaS EA, SaaS ERM, Financial Cloud, EPM, and PLM markets according to IDC. It is the sole Chinese vendor recognized in the Asia-Pacific SaaS ERP Mid-Small Market Competitiveness Report and the only Chinese management software provider in Gartner’s AI Code Assistants Market Guide. Competitors likely include other global and domestic ERP and SaaS providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, Kingdee reported revenue of approximately RMB6.26 billion, a 10.2% increase year-on-year, with cloud services revenue growing 13.4%. The company recorded a net loss attributable to owners of RMB142 million, narrowing from prior years. Cloud subscription ARR grew 20% to RMB3.43 billion. Operating cash flow improved by 42.9% to RMB934 million. The company employs over 12,000 staff and maintains significant R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kingdee emphasizes empowering enterprises through AI-driven intelligent management cloud platforms that liberate creativity and enhance productivity. Its unique value lies in integrating AI with ERP tailored to Chinese management paradigms, delivering scenario-based AI agents, and providing comprehensive SaaS solutions across enterprise sizes. The company’s strong localization, ecosystem partnerships, and continuous innovation in AI and cloud services differentiate it in the competitive enterprise software market.
